<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template for the carbonyl‑ene reaction described. We'll search the template catalog for a template that breaks a ketone (C=O) and an alkene (C=C) and forms a new C‑C bond and a C‑O bond (alcohol). This should give us a template ID we can then apply to the target molecule.</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "C=C(c1ccccc1)C1CCCC1(OH)C(F)(F)F",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["ketone", "alkene"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["alcohol"],
    "bonds_broken": ["C=O", "C=C"],
    "bonds_formed": ["C-C", "C-O"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
